description: Returns one supplier's public profile on Mati Logistics. Use it to look closer at a supplier from discover_suppliers. Returns its overview, highlights, products, customers, capabilities, certifications, shipment count, similar suppliers and the url of its page; fields the page shows only to signed-in readers are left out and counted as `locked`. Contact details are never included; the page and its `rfq_url` are how to reach the supplier. Read-only, no side effects, free.

slug.description: The supplier's slug, as returned by discover_suppliers (e.g. "acme-valves-co"). A /supplier/<slug> path is accepted too.

name: get_supplier
title: Get supplier
